zh.title: 没有终端，AI 数字员工还能核对设备清单吗？
zh.summary: 同一张设备清单工单，三种工具条件，交出的结果各不相同。实测岗位说明、取数能力与可核验报告之间的关系。

en.title: Can an AI worker check an equipment list without a terminal?
en.summary: One equipment-list assignment, three tool setups. A CodeFlowMu experiment traces what each AI worker could read and what it could hand back.
